title: Slice 626975: [Expense Agent] Alternate approvers - Delegated/Substitutes (November '26)
summary: Expense Agent now supports alternate approvers and delegated/substitute workflows. Users can designate alternate approvers for expense approvals and generate delegation reports.
key_points: New alternate approvers table and page for managing substitute approvers
Approval logic updated to route expense reports to alternate approvers when configured
New API endpoint for managing alternate approvers
Added delegation report for tracking approval substitutions
Expanded permission sets to support new expense agent functionality
